content:
Rumors suggest the AirPods 5 will be unveiled next week alongside the iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12, as well as the iPhone Ultra. Here's what's currently known about the new AirPods.

The AirPods 5 are expected to debut at the September 9 event in two models, but without cameras

Apple's most important annual event will be held next week on September 9. In addition to new iPhone and Apple Watch models, there may also be home products, and the AirPods 5 are also expected to launch simultaneously.

The AirPods 4 were released in 2024, and historically Apple has typically spaced its generations two to three years apart. The original AirPods launched in 2016, AirPods 2 in 2019, AirPods 3 in 2021, and AirPods 4 in 2024. Judging from the timeline, a release this year broadly fits the previous cadence.

However, surprisingly, rumors and leaks about this new AirPods model have been very scarce.

Most recent AirPods rumors have centered on a new model equipped with cameras. Earlier, a video leaked from Apple software showed a model with cameras, sparking speculation that it would launch soon.

However, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman said that AirPods with cameras won't arrive until 2027. But he expects the AirPods 5 without cameras to make their debut at Apple's September event. He wrote earlier:

Gurman further added in a post on X that the AirPods 5 will come in two different models:

  • With Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)
  • Without ANC

In an earlier report, Gurman noted that he doesn't expect the AirPods 5 to include the heart rate sensor from the AirPods Pro 3, but that Apple is "looking to add more health features to AirPods over time, including body temperature detection." He also separately mentioned that Apple is developing "an H3 chip targeted at lower latency and better sound quality."

It remains unknown whether the AirPods 5 will adopt the H3 chip. When Apple launched the H2 chip, it was initially exclusive to the AirPods Pro lineup.

However, the AirPods 5 could potentially include new health sensors, and H3 is also a possibility. Beyond that, details about the AirPods 5 remain quite limited at this stage. Perhaps Apple will surprise us with the AirPods 5 announcement, much like it did earlier this year when it released the AirPods Max 2.

What features would you like to see on Apple's next-generation AirPods? Let us know in the comments.
